title: Prove the E8 d=0 kernel floor and scoped rigid C1 bounds
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proves **C7: cost(S)>=72 for the d=0, nonzero-kernel branch** left open in [PR3074](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3074), [PR3154](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3154) and [Discussion3156](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156). The bound is sharp over every characteristic-zero field in the one-sided E8 lift model of PR2816. The reusable theorem bounds exact-swap-eligible root rank by correction-space basis cost, retaining actual scalar coefficients; the full-remainder inequality **24>21** then closes the kernel case.

The extension also establishes these scoped d=0 C1 results:

- **CONJG2 Section 2(ii), kappa<=7:** every weight-eight high normal is an E8 root direction, excluding nonroot D7/E6 types, independently of the actual low-basis total.
- **Actual low-basis total Sigma=7:** corrected invoice >=65 and pivot invoice >=64. Actual total eight is also excluded when minimum correction cost kappa<=7 or a minimum basis has profile `(7,1)`; the latter uses the simultaneous-incidence contradiction **168>148**.
- **Residual F1:** the implication holds through support size 24, sharply, with a literal failure at 25. Together with the `(7,1)` exclusion, this discharges F1 on all surviving d=0 rigid low-invoice candidates. The unrestricted cost-eight F1 extension is false; the boundary fixture is not a complete C1 decoder counterexample.

**Every C1 decoder consequence assumes PR3154's rigid shape and high-member duality, corrected ledger `cost(D') = sum_j w(A_j) - n_c`, pivot rebate `epsilon_k in {0,1}`, and N8 (at most eight corrections with distinct frame indices). This package does not independently validate that broader reduction.** Minimum cost kappa and actual total Sigma remain distinct. Other C1 cases, C2-C6, a complete L120 theorem, suppliers and the selected frontier remain outside this contribution.

## Task and overlap

Base `997e6a9ca7b4f95d50e366f61412fd640d72a88a`, priority revision 6. Scope changed from `complex-rank-shape-decoder` to the named decoder-floor handoff; the original card, reason, exact source heads and bounded coverage are retained in `TASK.json` and `SOURCES.json`. PR3154 is pinned at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`.

The 2026-10-17 13:14 UTC overlap refresh covered 283 open PRs, 2,556 closed PRs and 1,932 Discussion records. No matching C7 or scoped C1 completion was found. Adjacent [PR3158](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3158), [PR3160](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3160), [PR3161](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3161), [PR3162](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3162) and [PR3163](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3163) concern C5. The reduction's author is consolidating those results and actively working on C6, expressly leaving C1-C4 and C7 open. Public coordination remains pending donor approval. Only `research/e8-d0-root-swaps/` is added.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-d0-root-swaps
```

Registered replay passed in **8.40 s**; a read-only Git-free optimized export passed in **7.97 s**. Coverage includes 511 hyperplanes and the cap-64 check in both coordinate models, 256 parabolics, 120 root remainders, five normal families, actual coefficient fixtures, 56 connected-deletion configurations, 57,120 frame-plane cases per model and eighteen rejection controls. Two additional cap-65 source mutants fail their mathematical guards. The coordinate methods share expected profiles and authorship: they are an internal cross-check, not independent review.

Three unchanged Lean 4.21.0/mathlib files previously compiled without warnings, using only the standard reported axioms, and were separately rechecked by the auditor. They formalize partial coefficient and connected-cover cores. **E8 instantiation and the complete C7/C1 arguments remain unformalized.** A separate read-only AI audit independently reconstructed the finite inputs and found no demonstrated mathematical error. Hosted CI, predecessor long suites and independent human review have not been run.

## Credit

Credit DreamingOfClouds' [PR1590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1590) (two-factor lemma), [PR2816](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2816) (model and parabolic argument), [PR2862](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2862) (carrier predecessor), [PR2985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2985) (cap context), PR3074 and PR3154 (open obligations and conditional decoder model), and CubeJerry's [PR3095](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3095) (support chart and field scope). Adjacent C5 work retains its credit.

## Open next questions

The package’s [Open next questions](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c2a62363ad4945e8803fedea6ead78e1ad412b2/research/e8-d0-root-swaps/README.md#open-next-questions) and [structured handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c2a62363ad4945e8803fedea6ead78e1ad412b2/research/e8-d0-root-swaps/TASK.json) retain the remaining C1 profiles/pivot cases, full formalization, and C6/reduction review. C6 is already actively claimed; coordinate before taking it. The smallest direct follow-up is a remaining cost-eight C1 profile with its actual shared coefficients and pivot conditions retained.
